meta.title: 如何引导摆姿摆姿呢？一个视频教会你。
meta.title_en: How to Guide a Model Into Poses

scenes.context: 今天学习人像美姿技巧，先解决站姿不稳的问题。
sentences: 今天我们学习人像美姿技巧。
Today we study portrait posing skills.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达美姿学习
Today's lesson is all about posing people well.
换种说法表达站姿不稳
First, fix the wobble before worrying about the look.
scenes.speak: Today we study portrait posing skills. Standing unsteadily is the first thing to fix, so here are some tips for standing poses.

scenes.context: 小姐姐不会摆 pose，拍完几张后我们可以引导一下。
sentences: after a few shots（拍完几张后）
We can guide her a little.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达不会摆
The model freezes up and doesn't know what to do.
换种说法表达引导节奏
Shoot a few first, then start giving direction.
scenes.speak: The model says, "I can't pose." After a few shots, we can guide her a little with simple directions.

scenes.context: 手臂微微转侧、手放下巴位置，单手美字逻辑配竖构图显修长。
sentences: Turn the arm slightly to the side.
可以放在下巴这个位置。
It can rest near the chin.
单手美字的逻辑是什么呢。
What's the logic behind the hand pose?
paraphrase: 换种说法表达手部姿势
Angle the arm and bring the hand toward the jaw.
换种说法表达构图目的
A vertical frame makes the figure look longer.
scenes.speak: Turn the arm slightly to the side and let the hand rest near the chin. For the hand pose, think about the logic: a vertical composition makes the figure look longer.

scenes.context: 小姐姐正面对着你蹲，先看脚法，脚往前伸更修长。
sentences: 让它把脚往前伸一点点。
Ask her to stretch the foot a little forward.
It makes the leg look longer.
paraphrase: 换种说法表达脚往前伸
Have her ease the foot forward just an inch.
换种说法表达显腿长
That tiny shift lengthens the whole leg line.
scenes.speak: Everyone, watch the footwork first. Ask her to stretch the foot a little forward — it makes the leg look longer.

scenes.context: 靠姿用第四个脚部去靠，帽子等道具互动让画面更丰富。
sentences: 靠姿的话 第四个脚部去靠。
For leaning poses, lean on the fourth point of support.
A hat works the same way.
是不是画面也丰富一点。
It makes the frame richer, right?
paraphrase: 换种说法表达靠姿支撑
Use a fourth contact point when leaning.
换种说法表达道具互动
Props like hats add layers to the frame.
scenes.speak: For leaning poses, lean on the fourth point of support. A hat works the same way — props make the frame richer.

practice: Today we study portrait posing skills.
We can guide her a little with directions.
A vertical composition makes the figure look longer.
A hat is a prop that adds layers.
pitfalls: 切换构图避免千篇一律
shifts: 手臂、下巴、脚法、支撑点全链路
footer_notes: 来源：如何引导摆姿摆姿呢？一个视频教会你。（小红书，时长43分钟）
